corrections.text: The article's "What We Don't Know" section states that "Neither AWS's announcement nor its Compute Blog post specifies which Nitro-based instance families, beyond 'most,' support Nitro Sandboxes." This is incorrect. The AWS Compute Blog post does specify the supported instance scope: "Every EC2 instance type that supports Nitro Enclaves, across general purpose, compute optimized, memory optimized, storage optimized, and accelerated families, on AWS Graviton, Intel, and AMD processors."
